title: Rafaga canonical scene
description: Geometry handed from api to solver (ADR-04). Produced by api (services/scene) from base buildings + one alternative's facade elements; consumed by solver (services/voxelize). Pure local metric frame: x east, y north, z up, metres, origin = project anchor. Contains NO geographic coordinates. Every primitive is a vertical prism (footprint polygon extruded from z_min to z_max). Facade strategies are already expanded into primitives; the solver never interprets facade parameters. Thin solids (thickness < dx) are kept as solids; the solver applies the sub-grid rule (ADR-13).

h_max_m.description: Maximum height over BASE buildings; drives BR-16 domain margins so every alternative of a project shares the same grid (ADR-23).

bounds.description: Axis-aligned bounds of base buildings in ENU and the fixed facade envelope added around them (FACADE_ENVELOPE_M = 10).

ref.description: facade element id or building id

ring.description: Simple polygon ring, counter-clockwise for outer rings and clockwise for holes, closing vertex NOT repeated, no self-intersection (api validates with shapely).

element_id.description: facade element id; null for plain buildings

id.description: Stable within a scene; e.g. b:<building_id>:t0, f:<element_id>:3

solid.description: Impermeable prism: buildings, building tiers (imports, setbacks), fins, canopies.

thin_axis_m.description: Smallest horizontal dimension (thickness) for fins/canopy edges; lets the solver decide sub-grid treatment without recomputing.

oneOf.title: screen
oneOf.description: Porous screen (celosía). Loss coefficient precomputed by api with Idelchik: zeta = ((0.707*sqrt(1-beta) + 1 - beta)/beta)^2 (ADR-13). Force acts on the velocity component along `normal` and is spread over thickness_m (solver uses max(thickness_m, dx)).

normal.description: Unit vector, outward from the building edge, horizontal.

oneOf.title: vegetation
oneOf.description: Canopy drag volume: F = -rho * drag_coefficient * lad * |u| u (ADR-13).

x-generation-rules.building: One solid per building (or one per tier when tiers are present), z_min = tier z_from (0 for plain buildings).
x-generation-rules.setback: Edge edge_index of the building footprint is offset inward by setback_m * k for tier k = 1.. above start_floor; tier k spans [start_floor*floor_height + (k-1)*floor_height, ...] up to building height; the original single solid is replaced by stacked setback_tier solids; a degenerate (invalid or area < 1 m2) tier stops the stack with warning setback_tiers_truncated.
x-generation-rules.screen: Rectangle parallel to the edge, offset outward by offset_m, length = edge length, thickness 0.1 m, z 0..min(height_m, building height).
x-generation-rules.fins: floor((L - thickness)/pitch)+1 rectangles perpendicular to the edge, starting at edge start + pitch/2, depth outward = depth_m, thickness_m wide, z 0..height (default building height). thin_axis_m = thickness_m.
x-generation-rules.canopy: Rectangle along the edge, overhang_m outward, z from height_m to height_m + 0.3, clamped below building height. thin_axis_m = 0.3.
x-generation-rules.vegetation: Rectangle along the edge, starting offset_m outward, width_m deep, z 0..height_m, lad and drag_coefficient = user setting vegetation_cd.
x-generation-rules.orphaned: An element whose building/edge no longer exists is skipped with warning element_orphaned.
x-generation-rules.outward: Outward normal of edge i (CCW ring) = edge direction rotated -90 degrees (right-hand side).
